storySection.title: Our story
storySection.p1:
Before that day, we had shared many conversations over the phone, slowly getting to know each other. Yet there was still so much we had never said.
Then came the day we finally met at the café we had chosen. She arrived before me, and when I saw her for the first time, something in my heart changed.
What had begun through conversations suddenly felt real, and I found myself drawn to her in a way I could not explain. In that moment, I knew I wanted to spend my life with her.
storySection.p2: And by God's grace, that first meeting led us here—to this beautiful chapter of our lives, together.
